purpose: Keep the job-application ecosystem current from one governed source while separating the admitted public portfolio subset from the authenticated owned-estate intelligence substrate, without copying child repository source or maintaining competing inventories.

truth_model.child_source_authority: Each reference child repository owns its code, README, tests, releases, and repository-native receipts.
truth_model.portfolio_authority: Helix owns admitted-portfolio classification, authenticated-estate compiler policy, evidence-bound lineage and support assertions, capability projection, company alignment, second-depth progression, and public/private projection boundaries.
truth_model.projection_rule: Downstream systems consume links, public-safe policies, and generated snapshots only. They do not become independent sources of portfolio truth, and public consumers never require the authenticated census or private estate identities.

sources.role: Source-bound current public recruiter inventory snapshot; count is derived from the inventory manifest and is not the full authenticated owned estate
Projection, provenance, and no-copy policy for the admitted portfolio
Source-bound repository URLs and live-link contract
SHA-bound repository observations and evidence state
Crown-jewel hierarchy, public boundary, and next gates
Company-track index and dossier shard contract
Company-specific evidence progression, stage prerequisites, blockers, next gates, and public claim ceilings
Authenticated owned-estate compiler policy for namespace isolation, lineage collapse, reference systems, capability donors, company projection, and public-safe output
Public-safe role-capability rules, complete ranked audience projections, non-authoritative presentation defaults, support ancestry semantics, and truth boundaries
Evidence-bound namespace, lineage, and support assertions for private estate compilation; unsupported relations remain unpromoted
Dated external company operating-pressure snapshot with official-source observations separated from GlacierEQ inference and explicit refresh requirements

projections.boundary: The public portal may consume only public-safe estate policy and external-intelligence metadata. It must not consume estate_facts, the authenticated census, private repository identities, legal-private records, or raw owned-estate cardinality.
Résumé projections may use public-safe role and company intelligence policy but may not consume estate_facts, authenticated census records, or private repository identities.
Private estate facts may inform internal compilation, but generated company packets must pass the estate public-safe projection boundary before publication.
Machine-public surfaces inherit the same hard exclusion of authenticated census rows, estate_facts, legal-private identities, and raw owned-estate cardinality.
Cloud projections may hold private operational metadata, including evidence-bound estate assertions, but public projections must consume only public-safe fields.

event_triggers: company second-depth stage or evidence change
estate compiler or projection policy change
evidence-bound estate namespace lineage or support assertion change
required_sequence: validate all required control-plane source files
reconcile the current public-portfolio inventory from its source manifest without assuming a fixed repository count
validate company second-depth stages, prerequisites, blockers, and claim ceilings
verify every HELIX_ADMITTED repository maps to admitted inventory
verify every admitted inventory child maps to at least one governed track
when authenticated estate authority is available, census the full owned estate without committing private census rows
apply evidence-bound namespace lineage and support assertions fail closed
compile reference systems capability donors company projections and experiment state
compile public-safe and private projections separately
update_contract.consumer_behavior: Consumers must reject missing required sources, schema drift, duplicate identities, private-record leakage, unsupported claims, stale source receipts, second-depth stage claims that lack their declared prerequisites, and any public surface that exposes authenticated-estate identities or cardinality.

invariants: The admitted inventory root plus workspace repository count equals its total_repositories field.
The current inventory is a public-portfolio snapshot whose count is derived from source; it is not a fixed estate ceiling.
Authenticated owned-estate cardinality and private repository identities remain runtime-private and absent from downstream public bundles.
Workspace repository identities in the admitted inventory are unique.
Every HELIX_ADMITTED dossier repository exists in the admitted reference inventory.
Every admitted reference inventory child appears in at least one company or GlacierEQ Core dossier.
Every required company track resolves to a fail-closed second-depth state; missing overrides never imply completion.
Second-depth stages are monotonic and public claim ceilings may not exceed the strongest satisfied stage prerequisites.
Evidence-bound dependency and reference support never collapses lineage or counts as an independent accomplishment.
Legal-private estate material is hard-isolated from company, recruiter, resume, and machine-public projections.
L0, QUARANTINED, EXCLUDED, and private-only records never enter public recruiter projections.
Company naming never implies affiliation, endorsement, employment, proprietary access, contract relationship, clearance, or production deployment.
Repository ownership does not by itself establish authorship, originality, security, runtime success, or recruiter readiness.
Downstream projections may change presentation but may not change factual IDs, evidence states, second-depth stages, claim ceilings, test counts, blockers, or authority boundaries.
Company and audience projections preserve complete eligible relation membership; ranking, compact proof views, and pagination never define what exists.
